description: This file contains a data migration class for setting up and updating SQL index tables related to content fields in OrchardCore CMS, including creating tables, indexes, and schema modifications.

classes.name: Migrations
classes.description: A sealed class responsible for managing database schema migrations for content field indexing in OrchardCore.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Performs initial creation of index tables and indexes for various content field types.

methods.name: UpdateFrom1Async
methods.description: Adds BigUrl and BigText columns to LinkFieldIndex table; marked for removal in future versions.

methods.name: UpdateFrom2Async
methods.description: Creates MultiTextFieldIndex table; marked for removal in future versions.

methods.name: UpdateFrom3Async
methods.description: Recreates indexes for TextFieldIndex and BooleanFieldIndex; marked for removal in future versions.

methods.name: UpdateFrom4Async
methods.description: Attempts to drop obsolete indexes and modify Time field; marked for removal in future versions.

methods.name: UpdateFrom5Async
methods.description: Handles schema updates related to TimeFieldIndex, including dropping and recreating indexes.
